title: Building with Numbers Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of place value, addition, subtraction, measurement, and telling time!

questions.question: In the number 583, what digit is in the tens place?
questions.explanation: In 583, the 8 is in the tens place. It represents 80.

questions.question: Which symbol correctly completes this: 245 ___ 254?
questions.explanation: 245 is less than 254, so we use the < symbol. Both have 2 hundreds, but 4 tens is less than 5 tens.

questions.question: What is 38 + 45?
questions.explanation: 38 + 45 = 83. Add the ones: 8 + 5 = 13, write 3 carry 1. Add the tens: 3 + 4 + 1 = 8.

questions.question: What is 72 - 38?
questions.explanation: 72 - 38 = 34. Borrow from the tens: 12 - 8 = 4 ones. 6 - 3 = 3 tens.

questions.question: How many inches are in one foot?
questions.explanation: There are 12 inches in one foot.

questions.question: When the short hand points to 5 and the long hand points to 12, what time is it?
questions.explanation: When the short hand is on 5 and the long hand is on 12, the time is 5:00 (5 o'clock).

questions.question: What is the value of the 6 in the number 629?
questions.explanation: The 6 is in the hundreds place, so it represents 600.

questions.question: What time does the clock show when the long hand points to 6?
questions.explanation: When the long hand points to 6, it is half past the hour (30 minutes past).
